name: gizza-ai/pem-bundle-splitter
summary: Split PEM bundles into labeled blocks

tool.description: Split a multi-block PEM bundle into individual labeled blocks in input order. Reports the PEM label, friendly type, category counts, DER byte length, suggested filename, and optional SHA-256 fingerprint. Supports certificates, private/public keys, CSRs, params, PGP/OpenSSH blocks, and unknown PEM labels.

fingerprints.description: Include a SHA-256 fingerprint of each block's decoded DER bytes.

output.description: Output format: readable report, structured JSON, or cleaned individual PEM blocks.

pem.description: Concatenated PEM bundle text containing one or more -----BEGIN ...----- / -----END ...----- blocks.
